author: cburgmer

english.text: Have you eaten yet?

jyutping: sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3？
text: 食咗飯未呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He did nothing wrong.

jyutping: keoi5 mou4 zou6 co3。
text: 佢無做錯。

author: nickyeow

english.text: All you have to do is sign your name here.

jyutping: nei5 hai2 dou6 cim1 go3 ming4 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你喺度簽個名就得㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.

jyutping: keoi5 gui6 dak1 zai3，jau6 m4 gau3 fan3，zeot1 zi1 mai6 gaau2 dou3 beng6 zo2 lo1。
text: 佢攰得濟，又唔夠瞓，卒之咪搞到病咗囉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: As the elevator is out of order, we must go down the stairs.

jyutping: bou6 lip1 waai6 zo2，so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 haang4 lau4 tai1 lok6 heoi3。
text: 部𨋢壞咗，所以我哋要行樓梯落去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't laugh at him.

jyutping: m4 hou2 siu3 keoi5 laa1。
text: 唔好笑佢啦。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I will study abroad when I have finished school.

jyutping: ngo5 bat1 zo2 jip6 zi1 hau6 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1。
text: 我畢咗業之後諗住去外國讀書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Please introduce me to a cute girl.

jyutping: gaai3 siu6 go3 leng3 neoi2 bei2 ngo5 sik1 laa1。

author: fercheung

english.text: Tom is too honest a boy to tell a lie.

jyutping: Tom zai2 hou2 lou5 sat6，m4 sik1 gong2 daai6 waa6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you drink tea?

jyutping: nei5 jam2 m4 jam2 caa4 gaa3？

jyutping: nei5 waa2 jyu4 gwo2 jat1 jat6 jau5 jaa6 baat3 go3 zung1 gei2 hou2 aa1。

english.text: Money is the only thing that matters to him.

jyutping: deoi3 keoi4 loi4 gong2 dak1 cin4 sin1 hai6 man6 tai4。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I enjoyed spending time with you.

jyutping: tung4 nei5 gung6 cyu2，zan1 hai6 faai3 wut6。
text: 同你共處，真係快活。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I finally feel appreciated.

jyutping: zung1 jyu1 jau5 jan4 zi1 ngo5 laa3！
text: 終於有人知我喇！

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Don't mention this matter.

jyutping: m4 hou2 tai4 ne1 joeng2。
text: 唔好提呢樣。

english.text: The devil finds ways to get people to adopt his tricks and give these festivals in the name of so-called Christianity, with the aim of humiliating the great Jehovah God. His plot succeeded.

text: 魔鬼想方設法使人採納佢嘅詭計，搞個所謂基督教嘅名義畀呢啲節日，目的係要羞辱偉大嘅耶和華上帝。 佢嘅陰謀得逞咗。

english.text: In the family, one can find an uncle and an aunt, a mother and a father, a son and a daughter, a grandson and a granddaughter, as well as a brother and a sister, the father's uncle or the mother's and the father's aunt or the mother's, the brother's and sister's son or daughter, and the wife's or husband's brother or sister.

text: 喺家庭入面，可以搵到一個叔叔同一個姨姨，一個母親同一個父親，一個兒子同一個女兒，一個孫子同一個孫女，同埋一個兄弟同一個妹妹，父親嘅叔叔或者母親同父親嘅姨姨或者係母親、兄弟姊妹嘅兒子或女兒，同埋妻子或丈夫嘅兄弟姊妹。

english.text: If you were a sailor before the invention of modern navigational equipment, lighthouses were treasured beacons for wandering seafarers. They once dotted U.S. coastlines. But with advances in navigation equipment, lighthouses have become obsolete and many are no longer used for navigational purposes by major shipping traffic. Many lighthouses are threatened by changes in geography due to erosion and natural disasters, are vandalized, or are in desperate need of repair.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 jin6 doi6 hong4 hoi2 cit3 bei6 faat3 ming4 zi1 cin4 ge3 seoi2 sau2，dang1 taap3 zau6 hai6 lau4 long6 hoi2 jyun4 ge3 zan1 gwai3 seon3 biu1。 keoi5 dei6 cang4 ging1 hai2 mei5 gwok3 hoi2 ngon6 sin3 soeng6 min6 dim2 dim2 dik6 dik6。 daan6 hai6 ceoi4 zyu6 dou6 hong4 cit3 bei6 ge3 zeon3 bou6，dang1 taap3 ji5 ging1 gwo3 si4，ji4 ce2 hou2 do1 dang1 taap3 dou1 m4 zoi3 bei6 zyu2 jiu3 ge3 hong4 wan6 jung6 lai4 zou6 dou6 hong4。 hou2 do1 dang1 taap3 dou1 jan1 wai6 cam1 sik6 tung4 tin1 zoi1 ji4 sau6 dou3 dei6 lei5 bin3 faa3 ge3 wai1 hip3，jik6 dou1 sau6 dou3 po3 waai6，waak6 ze2 gik6 dou6 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 fuk6。
text: 如果你係現代航海設備發明之前嘅水手，燈塔就係流浪海員嘅珍貴信標。 佢哋曾經喺美國海岸線上面點點滴滴。 但係隨住導航設備嘅進步，燈塔已經過時，而且好多燈塔都唔再被主要嘅航運用嚟做導航。 好多燈塔都因為侵蝕同天災而受到地理變化嘅威脅，亦都受到破壞，或者極度需要修復。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made by him, and without him was not any thing made that was made. In him was life, and the life was the light of men. And the light shineth in darkness, and the darkness comprehended it not. There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

jyutping: hei2 co1 jau5 dou6，dou6 tung4 san4 jat1 cai4，dou6 zau6 hai6 san4。hai2 soeng6 dai3 ge3 hoi1 ci2 dou1 hai6 jat1 joeng6。so2 jau5 je5 dou1 hai6 jau4 keoi5 zou6 ge3，jyu4 gwo2 mou5 keoi5，zau6 mou5 jam6 ho4 je5 hai6 zou6 ceot1 lai4 ge3。hai2 keoi5 jap6 min6 jau5 sang1 ming6，ji4 sang1 ming6 zau6 hai6 jan4 ge3 gwong1。ji4 gwong1 hai2 hak1 am3 zung1 faat3 gwong1，ji4 hak1 am3 zau6 m4 wui6 lei5 gaai2 keoi5。jau5 jat1 go3 hai6 soeng6 dai3 paai3 lai4 ge3 jan4，keoi5 go3 ming4 hai6 joek3 hon6。
text: 起初有道，道同神一齊，道就係神。喺上帝嘅開始都係一樣。所有嘢都係由佢造嘅，如果冇佢，就冇任何嘢係造出嚟嘅。喺佢入面有生命，而生命就係人嘅光。而光喺黑暗中發光，而黑暗就唔會理解佢。有一個係上帝派嚟嘅人，佢個名係約翰。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: My Hongkonger friend Don and I often talked about contemporary sci-fi shows of the decades of the 1990s and the 2000s, as we sat eating delicious Oriental dishes and drinking tea at our favourite haunt in East Vancouver, BC. We compared the multiple series of Star Trek with Babylon 5. Don was convinced that Babylon 5 was too full of interspecies politics.

jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 pang4 jau5 Don seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 gong2 1990 nin4 doi6 tung4 2000 nin4 doi6 gei2 sap6 nin4 ge3 dong1 doi6 fo1 waan6 zit3 muk6，dong1 ngo5 dei6 zo6 hai2 BC dung1 wan1 go1 waa4 ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 oi3 ge3 dei6 fong1 sik6 gan2 mei5 mei6 ge3 dung1 fong1 coi3 sik1 tung4 jam2 gan2 caa4 go2 zan6。ngo5 dei6 zoeng1《sing1 zai3 mai4 hong4》ge3 do1 go3 hai6 lit6 tung4《baa1 bei2 leon4 5》bei2 gaau3，Don sam1 seon3《baa1 bei2 leon4 5》taai3 cung1 mun5 mat6 zung2 gaan1 zing3 zi6。
text: 我同我嘅香港朋友 Don 成日都會講1990年代同2000年代幾十年嘅當代科幻節目，當我哋坐喺 BC 東溫哥華我哋最愛嘅地方食緊美味嘅東方菜式同飲緊茶嗰陣。我哋將《星際迷航》嘅多個系列同《巴比倫5》比較，Don深信《巴比倫5》太充滿物種間政治。
